# CANDIDATE: VIX_RISING_BOS_BREAKOUT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We aim to capture short continuation moves when intraday VIX rises, price breaks a bearish swing low (BOS), and the EMA ribbon shows bearish alignment. This edge exists because rising VIX reflects increasing fear and momentum, while a bearish BOS with EMA9<EMA20<EMA50 indicates sustained downward pressure likely to persist.

## Mechanism

On the 5-minute chart: if VIX(1-minute) > VIX(5-minutes ago) + 0.3 points, and price makes a new low that breaks the prior swing low (bearish BOS), and EMA9 < EMA20 < EMA50 on the same bar, enter short at the bar's close. Exit: stop above the high of the breakout bar (or above the prior swing high); target 2× risk or trail using a chandelier exit on the short side. Regime filter: only trade when VIX is between 15-25 and trending up; avoid when VIX > 30 (excessive chop) or VIX < 12 (insufficient drive).
